background.description: Zero-density asymptotically AdS black brane with one canonical scalar and a phenomenological source potential.

boundary_conditions.interpretation: The coupled collocation domain includes both endpoints.
boundary_conditions.role: normalized conformal boundary and regular horizon

boundary_conditions.interpretation: The leading UV power is factored analytically; x_H sets the source-normalized horizon scale.

boundary_conditions.expression: A_E = x_H^2 u^2 C(u), C finite
boundary_conditions.interpretation: The leading scalar backreaction power is explicit.

boundary_conditions.expression: the transformed scalar equation is retained at u = 1
boundary_conditions.interpretation: No fitted horizon scalar datum is introduced.

configuration.ensemble: zero chemical potential and zero Maxwell field

equations.source_reference: Gubser and Nellore, arXiv:0804.0434, Eqs. (24)-(29), transformed to conformal gauge

numerical_method.nonlinear_solver: hybr then frozen TRF polish when required

scope: Numerical reproduction of two public curves in a classical, zero-density, single-scalar bottom-up model; not empirical QCD validation, a physical critical-temperature prediction, EMD, or iHQCD.
